book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: CART NECHW DANꞋ BZOJ POSTLW SAN PABLO C̱HE BEṈEꞋ CA' ŽEꞋ CORINTO

content: Pablon' cho'e diža' c̱he yeḻa' güešagna'
Na' c̱he dan' chṉabele neda' ḻe'e cart c̱helen', še beṉe' byon' bi chaclaže' si'e no'olen' gaque' xo'ole', güenṉa' chone'.

Perw na' že'chgua beṉe' chesedalene' no'ole bi nac no'ol c̱hegaque', na' beṉe' cheson bichle da' nac da' yeḻa' zto' len cuerp c̱hegaquen', na' da'nan' yejṉi'a gwšagna'le na' to to beṉe' byo soa xo'ole' na' to to no'ole soa beṉe' c̱he'.
Na' to to beṉe' byo cheyaḻa' gone' da' naquen gone' len no'ol c̱he' na' to to no'ole cheyaḻa' gone' da' naquen gone' len beṉe' c̱he'.
No'olen' bi gac ṉe' to gualaze' nac gone' len cuerp c̱hen' na' ṉeca beṉe' byon' bi gac ṉe' to gualaze' nac gone' len cuerp c̱hen', san cheyaḻa' yosozenag c̱he ḻježe'.

Na' le'e nšagna'le bi gwžonḻe gonḻen ḻježle da' cheyaḻa' gonḻe len cuerp c̱helen', perw še naquen yeḻa' güexi'a c̱he choptele guaccze bi gonḻen to term dao' cont soatezle yoḻ güižle Diosen'. Na' te termen' yezoalen ḻježle da' yoble, ḻe Satanás dan' chnabia' da' x̱igüe' ca' co'oyeḻan' le'e gonḻe da' mal še ḻeca žan soalen ḻježle.
Ba gwnia' yogo' da' ca' cont ṉezele de latje soa xo'olle, perw gague ṉacho chon Diosen' mandadw gwšagna'le.
Chebeda' šaca' soa yogo'le can' zoa' neda' nono xo'ola' zoa. Perw nža'le grasyw da' noṉ Diosen' to tocho c̱he bi da' goncho.
Na' le'e nac to gualazle, chacda' güench bi gwšagna'le, na' ḻecze le'e ba got beṉe' c̱hele bi yošagna'le, san soale to gualazle can' zoa' neda'.
Perw še ḻeca žan soalenḻe no'ole o soalenḻe beṉe' byo, yejṉi'a gwšagna'le cont bi ṉabia' yeḻa' chzelažen' le'e.
Na' le'e no'ole le'e nšagna'le, chona' mandadw bi yela'ale len beṉe' c̱helen'. Na' gague neda'ze žia' ca', ḻe naquen da' chon X̱ancho Criston' mandadw.

Na' še no'olen' yele'e len beṉe' c̱he', cheyaḻa' soa to gualaze' bi yeque'e beṉe' yoble o cheyaḻa' yeyeje' šjayzoalene' beṉe' c̱he' da' yoble. Na' ḻecze le'e beṉe' byo le'e nšagna'le, bi yela'ale len xo'ollen'.

Na' le'e beṉe' yezica'chle, ṉia' can' chona' xbab cheyaḻa' gonḻe, ḻa'czḻa' X̱anchon' bibi gwne' c̱he da' ca'. To to le'e beṉe' byo še ba nšagna'lenḻe no'ole bi chejnilaže' Criston' na' chaclaže' soalencze' le', bi cheyaḻa' yela'ale len ḻe'.
Na' to to le'e no'ole še ba nšagna'lenḻe beṉe' bi chejnilaže' Criston' na' chaclaže' soalene' le', bi yela'ale len ḻe'.

Bi naquen mal lao Diosen' soalenḻe beṉe' c̱hele o no'ol c̱hele beṉe' bi chejnilaže' Criston', ḻe Diosen' chi' yic̱hje' choptele dan' chejnilaže'lene' tole. Šaca' bi naquen ca', xi'iṉle ca' zjanacbe' ca xi'iṉ beṉe' bi chesejnilaže' Diosen', perw gague can', ḻe lente ḻegacbe' chi' yic̱hj Diosen' dan' chejnilaže'lene' tole.
Perw še beṉe' c̱hele o no'ole c̱hele bi chejnilaže' Criston' na' bich chaclaže' soalene' le'e, ḻe yela'a, ḻe Diosen' chaclaže' soacho binḻo len ḻježcho.
Na' le'e no'ole še gonḻe güen len beṉe' c̱hele na' le'e beṉe' byo še gonḻe güen len no'ol c̱helen', guacte gonen cont yesejnilaže' Criston'.
To tocho cheyaḻa' soacho goncho da' non X̱ancho Diosen' ḻo na'cho goncho cate' gwleje' chio' naccho xi'iṉe'. Chona' mandadw yesone' ca' gate'teze chesedop chesežague' chesonxene' Criston'.

Še ba zoale señw dan' že' circuncisión cate' gwlej Diosen' le'e nacle xi'iṉe', bi gonḻe cont yenit señon'. Na' še biṉa' soale señon' cate' gwlej Diosen' le'e nacle xi'iṉe', bi ṉable yosozoe' le'e señon'.
Bibi nonen len Diosen' še nsa'cho señw c̱he circuncisión o še bi nsa'chon. Da' naquen da' zeje, cheyaḻa' goncho con bi chaclaže' Diosen'.
Con can' naccho caten' gwlej Diosen' chio' naccho xi'iṉe', ca'tezeczen' cheyaḻa' soa cuezcho.
Še nacle esclavo cate' X̱ancho Diosen' gwleje' le'e, bibi sa'laže'le c̱he dan'. Perw še guata' latje c̱hixjwle cont chojle ḻo na' x̱anḻen', ḻe c̱hixjon na' yechojle.

Na' ḻa'czḻa' še nacle esclavo c̱he beṉe' cate' X̱ancho Criston' gwleje' le'e, Criston' ba naque' X̱anḻe ṉa'a, gague beṉac̱hen'. Na' chio' biṉa' gaccho esclavo c̱he beṉe', nac Criston' X̱ancho, na' guac ṉacho naccho esclavo c̱he'.
Da' zaca' xen da' ben X̱ancho Criston' cont bechojcho ḻo na' gwxiyen'. Da'nan' bi cheyaḻa' goncho xbab no beṉac̱h naque' x̱ancho.
Beṉe' migw, da' yoble žia' le'e, con can' naccho cate' gwlej Diosen' chio' naccho xi'iṉe', can' soa cuezcho, ḻe lao Diosen' chzoa chbezcho.

Na' can' cheyaḻa' gac c̱he no'ol güego' ca', X̱ancho Criston' bi bene' mandadw can' gac c̱hegacbe', perw neda' ṉia' can' chacda' cheyaḻa' gac, na' ba beyaše' beži'ilaže' X̱anchon' neda', na' da'nan' diža' da' choa' zaca'czen gwzenagle c̱hen.
Ba za' da' saca'zi'cho ṉa'a, na' da'nan' chacda' güench soa cuezcho con can' ba zoacho.
Le'e nšagna'le, bi yela'ale len xo'olle, na' le'e biṉa' soa xo'olle, bi c̱hiljw xo'olle.
Perw bi ṉacho naquen mal še gwšagna'le, na' ṉeca naquen mal še no no'ol güego' gwšagna'. Con da' zan da' zed de yežlio nga c̱he beṉe' zjanšagna', na' chaclaža' bi gac c̱hele ca'.
Beṉe' migw, chaclaža' ṉia' le'e da' nga: Bich chega'aṉ yezan iz cont goncho dan' ngüia Diosen' goncho. Da'nan' le'e zoa xo'olle cheyaḻa' soale gonḻe xšin Diosen' ca beṉe' nono xo'ole' zoa.

Na' še de da' yegüine'le, cheyaḻa' soale gonḻe xšin Diosen' ca beṉe' bi chegüine'. Na' še zoale mbalaz, cheyaḻa' soale gonḻe xšine' ca beṉe' bi zoa mbalaz. Na' še si'le bi da' si'le, cheyaḻa' soale gonḻe xšin Diosen' ca beṉe' bibi gwxi'e.
Na' še bi da' chc̱hinḻe da' de yežlio nga, bi cheyaḻa' cue' yic̱hjle c̱he ḻen, ḻe da' te c̱he yogo' da' chle'echo yežlio nga.
Na' chaclaža' bi cue' yic̱hjle c̱he da' ca' chac yežlio nga. Beṉe' nono xo'ole' zoa nḻatje' gone' xbab c̱he xšin X̱ancho Diosen' na' c̱he bi da' chaclaže' X̱anchon' gone'.
Perw beṉe' nšagne'e chi' yic̱hje' c̱he da' chac yežlio nga, ḻe chone' xbab c̱he bi da' chaclaže' xo'olen' gone', na' gague gac gone' xbab c̱he toz Diosen'.

Na' ḻecze nža' can' chac c̱he no'ole nšagna' na' c̱he no'olen' bi nšagna'. No'ole bi nšagna' mbec yic̱hje' c̱he xšin X̱ancho Diosen' na' chon cuine' ḻo ne'e do yic̱hj do laže'. Na' no'ole nšagne'e chbec yic̱hje' c̱he da' chac yežlio nga na' bi da' chaclaže' beṉe' c̱he' gone'.
Ba gwnia' ca' gague cont gwžona' gwšagna'le san cont gaclena' le'e. Con chaclaža' gaquele X̱ancho Diosen' do yic̱hj do laže'le sin cbi gwžonen gonḻe can' chazlaže'.

Na' še to beṉe' chacde' cheyaḻa' güe'e latje gwšagna' xi'iṉe' no'ole, na' še no'olen' ba ngole' na' chaclaže' gwšagne'e, nacczen güen gone' can' ba gwc̱hoglaže' gone' na' güe'e latje gwšagna' xi'iṉen'. Bi naquen mal gwnežjue' xi'iṉe' no'olen' beṉe' chṉabe' ḻe'.
Perw še zoa to beṉe' chacde' güench nono si' xi'iṉe' no'olen' na' bi ṉacho chonen byen gwšagna'be', nacczen güen gone' can' chazlažen' na' bi gwnežjue' bi' c̱hen' gwšagna'be'.
Can' naquen, beṉe' chnežjue' bi' c̱hen' chšagna'be' chone' güen, na' beṉe' bi chnežjue'be' chone' güench.
Na' note'teze no'ole nšagna', cheyaḻa' soe' len beṉe' c̱he'. Perw še ba got beṉe' c̱he', guac yeque'e beṉe' yoble, con še beṉe' chejnilaže' X̱ancho Criston'.
Perw chacda' neda' soache' mbalaz še yega'aṉe' to gualaze', na' chacda' xbab c̱hian' naquen toze len xbab c̱he Spiritw c̱he Diosen'.
